headline: Britain sentenced two Scattered Spider members to five and a half years for the Transport for London breach as CISA rushed federal agencies to patch an actively exploited Oracle flaw and China-linked espionage backdoors resurfaced across Asia.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep turning AI agents against their own users, with a new data-injection technique that makes a coding assistant run a stranger's command from a single fake GitHub comment while Intruder's vulnerability vending machine mints fresh zero-days.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Agents Weaponized and Data-Injection Attacks

emerging_trends.text: China-linked espionage crews resurfaced across Asia this week, dropping the Daxin rootkit inside a Taiwan manufacturer and the GoSerpent backdoor into Southeast Asian government networks.

Western courts squeezed cybercrime hard, sentencing two Scattered Spider members to five and a half years for the Transport for London breach as Dutch and Spanish police dismantled nine-figure investment fraud rings.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Scattered Spider Members Sentenced for TfL Hack

topics.title: AI Agents Weaponized and Data-Injection Attacks
topics.latest_developments: Researchers demonstrated a data-injection attack that corrupts the facts an AI agent trusts—one planted product review makes a shopping agent click Buy Now, one fake GitHub comment makes a coding assistant run a stranger's command—while Intruder unveiled a vulnerability vending machine that pairs code slicing with large language models and found an unknown WordPress plugin zero-day.
topics.summary: Offensive AI is maturing on both sides: attackers hide malicious instructions in data an agent reads, and defenders automate zero-day discovery, though researchers stress a finding still has to be proven before it counts. Organizations deploying AI agents should treat all agent-read content as untrusted input.

sources.title: New Agent Data Injection Attack Can Make AI Agents Misclick or Run Attacker Commands
We built a vulnerability vending machine: AI tokens in, zero-days out
AI Can Find Bugs, But Human Knowledge Still Proves Them

topics.title: Scattered Spider Members Sentenced for TfL Hack
topics.latest_developments: A British court sentenced two leading members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime collective to five years and six months each for the 2024 attack on Transport for London that cost the agency £29 million.
topics.summary: Scattered Spider, a loose collective known for social-engineering help desks, breached Transport for London in 2024, forcing service and refund system outages. The prison terms mark one of the first major convictions of the group's members.

sources.title: Scattered Spider members behind TfL hack get five years in prison
Scattered Spider hackers sentenced to 5.5 years over £29 million Transport for London hack

topics.title: Crypto-Theft Malware Targets macOS and Hardware Wallets
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek detailed ClickLock Stealer, a new macOS malware that uses social engineering and process killing to steal passwords and cryptocurrency from at least 100 users, while The Hacker News exposed OkoBot, a Windows framework running since April 2025 that injects seed-phrase phishing prompts into the legitimate Ledger and Trezor desktop apps.
topics.summary: Both families chase cryptocurrency: ClickLock bypasses macOS protections to grab credentials and wallets, and OkoBot waits for victims to open real hardware-wallet software before demanding their recovery phrase. Users should ignore any in-app request to re-enter a seed phrase.

sources.title: 'ClickLock Stealer' Bypasses macOS Security With Social Engineering, Process Killing
OkoBot Malware Framework Injects Seed Phrase Phishing Into Ledger and Trezor Apps

topics.title: China-Linked Backdoors Resurface Across Asia
topics.latest_developments: The Daxin kernel-mode rootkit reappeared after more than four years inside a Taiwan manufacturing firm alongside a new pre-login SYSTEM backdoor named Stupig, while Kaspersky detailed GoSerpent, an evolving backdoor stealing data from Southeast Asian government entities using the Stowaway RAT and a ThumbcacheService tool.
topics.summary: Symantec first documented Daxin in March 2022 as a stealthy rootkit tied to Chinese espionage; its return signals renewed targeting of Taiwanese industry and Southeast Asian governments. Both campaigns run two-phase intrusions built for long-term data theft.

sources.title: Daxin Resurfaces in Taiwan Alongside Stupig Pre-Login SYSTEM Backdoor
GoSerpent: a persistent threat evolves with sophisticated data collection and exfiltration

topics.title: Spirals Ransomware Encrypts in Under 24 Hours
topics.latest_developments: A new ransomware actor called Spirals ran an entire corporate intrusion—from initial access through data theft to encryption—in less than 24 hours.
topics.summary: Spirals compresses the ransomware kill chain into a single day, leaving defenders almost no window to detect and respond. Fast dwell-to-encryption times raise the premium on early identity and endpoint detection.

sources.title: New Spirals ransomware encrypts victim network in under 24 hours

topics.title: Active Exploitation of Oracle E-Business Suite
topics.latest_developments: CISA ordered federal agencies to patch the critical Oracle E-Business Suite financial-application flaw CVE-2026-46817 by Saturday, July 18, 2026, citing ongoing attacks.
topics.summary: CVE-2026-46817 is a privilege-management flaw in Oracle's E-Business Suite that attackers are exploiting in the wild. Agencies and enterprises running the financial application should apply Oracle's fix immediately.

sources.title: CISA orders feds to patch actively exploited Oracle flaw by Saturday

business_politics.title: U.S.-Iran War Widens as Hormuz Stays Shut
business_politics.latest_developments: The Financial Times warns the renewed Strait of Hormuz closure now threatens a fresh oil-supply crunch as the commercial stockpiles that cushioned the war's early shocks run low, even as crude steadied after three straight days of gains with U.S.-Iran diplomacy gridlocked.
business_politics.summary: The United States and Iran stay locked in open conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil passes; Washington has blockaded Iran's ports and kept striking Iranian targets, holding global energy markets on edge.

sources.title: Hormuz closure threatens renewed oil supply crunch
Oil Steadies After Gains But U.S.-Iran Tensions Remain High

business.title: Can Manufacturing Re-Emerge at Hazelwood Green?
business.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette feature asks whether Pittsburgh, and reclaimed industrial sites like Hazelwood Green, can anchor a manufacturing revival across Appalachia.
business.summary: The ReImagine Appalachia effort argues southwestern Pennsylvania's industrial legacy positions Pittsburgh—led by mill-site redevelopments such as Hazelwood Green along the Monongahela River—to recapture advanced manufacturing jobs.

sources.title: Reimagining Appalachia: Is the future of manufacturing hiding — and ready to re-emerge — here in Pittsburgh?

around_town.title: Commercial Street Bridge Comes Down on Parkway East
around_town.latest_developments: After PennDOT scrubbed Wednesday night's attempt for lack of daylight, crews imploded the Commercial Street Bridge over the Parkway East around 8 a.m. Thursday, July 16, dropping it in seconds.
around_town.summary: PennDOT closed the Parkway East (I-376) on July 10 for a 25-day project to replace the Commercial Street Bridge in Pittsburgh; District 11 executive Jason Zang said safeguards shielded the adjacent new span, and roughly 100,000 daily drivers stay on detours until the highway reopens.

sources.title: After delay, Commercial Street Bridge comes tumbling down
Commercial Street Bridge reduced to rubble with explosive demolition on Parkway East

around_town.title: Code Red Air Quality Lingers Into Friday
around_town.latest_developments: The Pennsylvania DEP's Code Red alert holds through Thursday, July 16, with the smoke expected to be worst overnight into Friday afternoon.
around_town.summary: Wildfire smoke from Canada and Minnesota pushed unhealthy pollution across Western Pennsylvania; the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection warns the air is unhealthy for everyone and urges limited time outdoors while highs reach the 90s.

sources.title: Wildfire smoke and poor air quality expected on Thursday in Pittsburgh | First Alert Weather

events.title: Picklesburgh Opens Downtown
events.latest_developments: Picklesburgh opens today, Thursday, July 16, and runs through Sunday, July 19, after drawing more than 200,000 people last year.
events.summary: Picklesburgh, the free pickle-themed food festival the Pittsburgh Downtown Partnership launched in 2015, fills Downtown Pittsburgh and the North Shore with vendors, live music, and pickle antics from noon to 10 p.m. Thursday through Saturday and noon to 6 p.m. Sunday; details at picklesburgh.com.

sources.title: Picklesburgh returns to Downtown Pittsburgh for another summer. Here's when and where.

around_teams.title: Pirates' Second-Half Playoff Push
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette laid out five storylines as the Pirates open the second half in Cleveland chasing a wild-card berth, centered on ace Paul Skenes.
around_teams.summary: Pittsburgh's Pirates reached the All-Star break within range of a National League wild card; Post-Gazette writers flag Paul Skenes, a revamped offense, and coming roster decisions as the keys to whether the club stays in the race.

sources.title: 5 second-half storylines to watch as the Pirates vie for a playoff spot

team_usa.title: USMNT's Home World Cup, In Pictures
team_usa.latest_developments: With Spain and Argentina set for Sunday's final, ESPN published a photo retrospective of the U.S. men's national team's home World Cup, which ended in the round of 16.
team_usa.summary: The 2026 World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico, held American attention for a month before the U.S. men lost 4-1 to Belgium in the round of 16; ESPN collected the images that defined the run.
